title: I Lov Watr
description: This data pack contains a “water points” system, where the player's actions regarding water will decrease or increase these points, resulting in either positive(dolphin grace) or negative effects(blindness, poisoning, and stunted crop growth).
body:
I Lov Watr is my very first data pack, created with an important mission. It turns ordinary survival into an ecological challenge. Now your actions directly affect the state of the world's water. This is not just a game, it is a story about how easy it is to destroy a fragile ecosystem and how important it is to protect it.



Water Points (WP) System

The main feature of the datapack is the dynamic Water Points system. It is an indicator of the health of the aquatic world:



Pollution is punished: if you kill fish and harm the aquatic ecosystem in any way, your WP will drop. A low score will lead to catastrophic consequences: from poisoning to blindness in the water.

Care is rewarded: restore the ecosystem and keep order. A high WP level will give you dolphin grace and make the world around you truly alive.
